rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone or something that cannot go wrong.

example.english: This method is infallible and works every time.
example.traditional: 呢個方法真係唔會錯，次次都幫到手。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 zan1 hai6 m4 wui5 co3 ci3 ci3 dou1 bong1 dou3 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a method, treatment, or solution that is sure to produce the intended result, rather than usually for a person's accuracy.

example.english: If you follow this recipe, it is infallible.
example.traditional: 你照住呢個食譜整，一定得。
example.jyutping: nei5 ziu3 zyu6 ni1 go3 sik6 pou2 zing2 jat1 ding6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when a remedy or technique has worked every time it has been tried.

example.english: I’ve tried this home remedy several times, and it’s infallible every time.
example.traditional: 呢個偏方我試過幾次，真係百試百靈。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pin1 fong1 ngo5 si3 gwo3 gei2 ci3 zan1 hai6 baak3 si3 baak3 ling4
